global_notes: All evidence references are recollection of the Naruto manga and are unverified. Locators are arc-level only.
Unverified references cannot establish approved production ratings. No record is approved.
All seven Fit ratings were set before Power. Power was not used to raise any Fit.
Calculated role scores are intentionally omitted. The scoring engine derives them.
Character IDs are provisional until reconciled with the OpenCode catalogue.

characters.name: Naruto Uzumaki
characters.canonical_version: War-era Naruto (Fourth Great Ninja War arc, up to ch. 700): bonded with Kurama, with Sage Mode, Kurama chakra modes and Six Paths Sage Mode. Baryon Mode excluded.
characters.version_selection_reasoning: Strongest reasonably sustainable state: bonded Kurama access used repeatedly across the war arc. The one-off fatal Baryon Mode is excluded. Six Paths Sage Mode is treated as Conditional under rule GP-1 (granted power, retained and used repeatedly).
core_abilities: Shadow Clone Technique including clone knowledge feedback
conditional_abilities: Sage Mode (needs natural energy gathering, limited duration)
Kurama chakra cloak, Link Mode and chakra modes (bonded partner, duration and cost)
Tailed Beast Bomb and Rasenshuriken variants (high chakra cost, partner or preparation dependent)
Six Paths Sage Mode (granted by Hagoromo, retained and used repeatedly; policy-dependent under GP-1)
Chakra sharing with allies through Kurama (partner-dependent)
excluded_abilities: Direct interventions by Hagoromo and other external help
characters.rarity_justification: Apex fighter with two elite roles (Attacker and Tank) but no benchmark strategic, leadership or healing role. Protagonist status and narrative importance were not considered. Legendary would require a third elite role.

characters.name: Sasuke Uchiha
characters.canonical_version: War-era Sasuke (Fourth Great Ninja War arc, up to ch. 700): Eternal Mangekyo Sharingan, Rinnegan, Susanoo and Chidori variants.
characters.version_selection_reasoning: Strongest reasonably sustainable state: repeated use of Rinnegan and Mangekyo abilities across the war arc. Indra-related Six Paths power is treated as Conditional under GP-1, the same rule applied to Naruto.
conditional_abilities: Amaterasu and Kagutsuchi (eye strain, cooldown)
Rinnegan techniques including Amenotejikara (chakra cost, range)
Large-scale Susanoo and Indra's Arrow (high chakra cost; granted-power dependent under GP-1)
excluded_abilities: Curse Mark states from earlier periods
Boruto-era and anime-only or movie-only abilities
characters.rarity_justification: Epic. Benchmark Attacker, but only one elite role: Tank, Assassin and Support are competent rather than elite. Protagonist-rival status was not considered.

characters.rarity_justification: Epic. Benchmark Strategist fit gives an elite-level result in that role despite low Power. This is the weak-fighter, high-strategic-value case the rubric is meant to reward.

characters.rarity_justification: Epic. Benchmark Healer in a scarce role with Elite Power and a strong Attacker. Also meets the provisional Healer scarcity floor for Epic.
